# DigiNeom

> DigiNeom places degree-verified South Asian software engineers with companies in Europe and North America. Engineers work from co-working spaces DigiNeom manages — not from home, and not as a freelance marketplace.

DigiNeom is a talent company, not a software agency. Clients hire a verified engineer onto their own team. DigiNeom handles sourcing, degree and skill verification, contracts, invoicing, and the workspace. The client manages the work.

## Site

- Home: https://digineom.co
- Contact: https://digineom.co/contact
- Email: info@digineom.co
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/digineom

## What DigiNeom does

1. Sources software engineers in South Asia.
2. Independently verifies degrees, tests skills through live coding, and assesses English and references. Under 3% of applicants are placed.
3. Matches engineers to roles at companies in Europe and North America.
4. Seats every engineer in a premium co-working space DigiNeom manages (enterprise internet, power backup, company hardware, meeting rooms, access control).
5. Handles contracts, invoicing, performance reviews, and replacements.

## Who it is for

Software companies and engineering teams in Europe and North America that need additional engineers at Western output standard without a second local payroll. Typical savings versus North American or Western European rates: 60–75%.

## How a placement starts

Tell DigiNeom the role (stack, seniority, timezone overlap). DigiNeom vets and verifies. The client interviews a shortlist and chooses. The engineer starts from a managed co-working floor, on DigiNeom equipment, on the client's timezone.

## What DigiNeom is not

- Not a web design or digital marketing agency.
- Not a project outsourcing shop that delivers software on a statement of work.
- Not a freelance marketplace of remote home-based contractors.
